caption:
From the archive: October 2009, Stockholm. 🎾

17 years ago, on 25 October 2009, Marcos Baghdatis beat Olivier Rochus 6-1, 7-5 to win the Stockholm Open. It was his third ATP title, and his first since Zagreb in February 2007.

Three years earlier he had reached the Australian Open final. He finished his career with four ATP titles and a career-high ranking of No. 8.

What's your favourite Baghdatis moment? 🇨🇾

📸 Akademan / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.5 (Baghdatis at Indian Wells, 2006)

alt: Archive cover, 25 October 2009: Baghdatis ends the wait in Stockholm: his third ATP title and his first since February 2007. 17 years ago. Sepia photo of Marcos Baghdatis at Indian Wells in 2006.

The story: on Sunday 25 October 2009 Marcos Baghdatis, 24, beat Olivier Rochus 6-1, 7-5 in the Stockholm Open final, after top seed Robin Söderling gave a walkover in the semi-finals; 15 aces in the final.
The final: Stockholm Open final, Sunday 25 October 2009, Royal Tennis Hall, Stockholm: Marcos Baghdatis beat Olivier Rochus 6-1, 7-5, his third ATP title.
The career: 4 ATP titles; Australian Open final 2006; Wimbledon semi-final 2006; highest ranking No. 8; retired after Wimbledon 2019.
